reviewer: Claude stored caption and figure comparison at reduced size; not a radiologist review
decision: On 2026-11-18 the project owner decided that figures of findings are bound to finding requirements.
rule: A stored figure is bound to a finding requirement when a sentence of its published caption or stored source note names the finding, the sentence is about a selected panel, the fidelity checker finds no modality, state or side conflict, and the figure was looked at. A stated side binds that side; an unstated side binds each side only where the two sides are mirror images. Coverage is always partial.
method: Names of finding requirements and of their listed parts were matched against stored descriptions, allowing spelling variants and word forms. About 950 candidate pairs on 322 figures were read, and further pairs were added where the same caption names another finding requirement of its investigation. Each accepted figure was looked at on a contact sheet. The accepted rows were then read again as a set for consistency.

evidence_values.own_word: the quoted sentence uses the requirement’s own word for the finding
evidence_values.listed_term: the quoted sentence uses a term that the requirement lists among its required parts; listed_parts names those parts
evidence_values.kind_of: the quoted sentence names a kind of what the requirement names, or spells out its abbreviation

side_values.caption_states_side: the record states no side; the caption states this side or both sides
side_values.side_not_stated: the record and the caption state no side; bound on the mirror-image assumption
side_values.record_states_side: the figure record itself states the matching side
side_values.not_sided: the requirement has no left or right side

kind_of_reasons.arterial bleeding>vascular lesion: bleeding from an artery is a vascular lesion
kind_of_reasons.arteriovenous fistula>shunt: an arteriovenous fistula is a shunt
kind_of_reasons.fistulating>penetrating tract: a fistula is a penetrating tract
kind_of_reasons.haemorrhage>lesion: a haemorrhage into the gland is a lesion of it
kind_of_reasons.hepatic metastases>spread site: a hepatic metastasis is a site of spread
kind_of_reasons.venous injury>vascular lesion: an injured vein is a vascular lesion

not_bound.catch_all_requirements: Requirements for “every other” or “unlisted” findings, measurements, comparisons and acquisition descriptors are not bound.
not_bound.unconfirmed_notes: A finding that the stored description mentions only to say that the source’s suggestion, attribution or description of it is unconfirmed is not bound. A diagnosis that the description reports as the source’s own is accepted, and its basis quotes the whole sentence with any limit it states.
not_bound.lungs: A lung or pulmonary artery finding whose caption states no side is not bound, because the two sides are not mirror images.
not_bound.radiology_assistant_figures: None of the 116 stored Radiology Assistant figures has a recorded sentence that names a finding requirement.
not_bound.checker: About 770 further caption matches fail the checker because of malformed codes in the figure record.
